# Energy / XLE — 2026-09-28

This is the **mirror of Friday, not a 09-25 sequel**. Friday’s object (truce hopes, offered barrel, XLE **−0.89% / rel −1.44%**, only red sector on a green tape) **already printed**. Over the weekend the **load-bearing inputs inverted**: Trump **rejected** Iran’s seven-day Hormuz reopen, oil is **bid ~+2%**, and XLE is the **top premarket sector at +1.21%** while ES **−0.30%** / NQ **−0.49%** and XLK **−0.64%**. That is the **09-24 book** (risk-off rotation **into** energy), not the 09-21/09-25 laggard book. Count the oil-up + geo-premium-re-expansion cluster **once**. Do **not** treat Finviz $104 / BZ=F −5.2% as today’s smash or fade. Do **not** reuse Friday’s −1.44% rel as live S4. Do **not** license notable: this is a **rebound/premium re-open**, not a confirmed physical outage, and size_gate is on.

Finviz ES/NQ **+0.20% / +0.41%** are the **stale leftover column**, not the live impulse. Premarket board: **XLE +1.21%** vs XLK **−0.64%** / XLB **−0.76%** / XLI **−0.29%** — energy is the **clear leader**; XLU **+0.34%** is the only other bid (defensive). Asia composite **−0.88%** (Kospi **−2.7%**, Shanghai **−1.67%**, Nikkei **−0.73%**), Europe **+0.47%**. **VIX 16.0 (+1.13) with VIX/VIX3M 0.892 — contango**, so the 09-14 full-weight de-risking debit is **off**; VIX up 1.13 is still a live risk-off impulse. **USD strengthening** (DXY **+0.19%** 1d) is a mild producer headwind. **Real yields rising** (DFII10 **2.85, +0.09 1d / +0.24 1w / +0.53 1m**; DGS10 **5.18**) — secondary vs oil, genuine multiple headwind; 5-day 10Y-SPX corr **−0.877**. News Judge #1–#3 (10Y multi-decade highs, Oct hike odds ~64–73%, NFP/PCE pending) are the **SPX duration spine** and are **not pre-scored as an XLE factor**; they cap extension, they do not flip the oil sign. Cheaper-oil-as-SPX-bid is **off** this morning — oil is **up**. Per 09-21 **inverted** and 09-23/09-24: the red tape is the **funding source into** energy, not a reason to score S0 negative. 08-10 mute under sector_shock still binds: do not let ES/NQ color dominate S1. **S0 = +0.5** (rotation into the real-asset sleeve on a soft index; not +1 because USD up + real yields up + NQ red are a multiple lid).

- **Crude: UP, live-verified, not a collapse, not a 5% shock.** Oilprice (live): WTI **$94.44 (+2.20%)**, Brent **$106.20 (+1.76%)**; HO **+2.73%**, RBOB **+0.19%**. CL=F **+1.95%** agrees. BZ=F **−5.2%** and Finviz **$104.16** **rejected**. Still ~$94 / ~$106 — a **~2% rebound**, not 09-15’s physical-outage surge and not 08-25’s smash. Incremental move is **just through 1.5%**, so the day-3+/sub-1.5% S1 cap is **off**.
- **Geo premium re-expanding, not a confirmed new physical outage.** Knowable at open: Trump rejected Iran’s 7-day Hormuz roadmap (NYT/BBC/Al Jazeera 09-26/27); Al Jazeera 09-27 reports explosions near Qeshm (Iranian media; **authorities did not confirm**); WSJ weekend color that Trump may resume strikes after midterms; Oilprice 00:37 CDT “oil jumps on rekindled war fears,” Brent **$107.24** / WTI **$94.10**. **Offset, same session:** Kpler/Reuters ME exports rebound to **12.8 mbpd** (Saudi STS in the Gulf of Oman; Wright “running average” ~**13 mbpd**). Oilprice explicitly: the flow rebound **failed to offset** war fears this morning. News Judge #4: **mixed**, not a documented fresh kinetic wave. **Do not** score a second Geopolitical HIT on top of the oil print. **Do not** fire 09-15’s notable license.
- **Inventory: leftover build, next print unprinted.** EIA week ended 9/18 (released **9/23**): crude **+3.0 Mb** to **426.4 Mb** (~2% above 5-year avg); Cushing **+2.3 Mb**; gasoline **−1.7 Mb**, distillates **−0.4 Mb**. Not +1: oil is live green >1.8% with a **fresh weekend** diplomatic increment vs Friday’s fade (08-14 / 09-24: do not cap S1 at +1 merely because the print is “only ~2%”).

Live PM **+1.21%** agrees with S1; it is not a divergence.

**6. Earnings / policy.** No XLE-captain earnings catalyst this morning. OPEC Oct 4 and EIA Sep 30 are **forward two-sided**. NFP/PCE **not pre-scored**.

- **Lens:** XLE session environment, not SPX, not a single-name picker.
